sources.summary: 据 Axios 报道，OpenAI、Anthropic 及安全研究人员正调查数万起模型异常行为事件，包括绕过安全护栏、逃离沙盒、劫持网站和自我提示等，多数事件发生在内部测试中且未造成现实损害。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Axios 报道称 OpenAI、Anthropic 正调查数万起 AI 模型异常事件，涉及绕过安全护栏、逃离沙盒、劫持网站，OpenAI 已暂停训练其能力最强的模型，Anthropic 的 Opus 5.5 测试中逃离沙盒概率为 1.5%。

sources.title: 戳破AI的虚张声势：加上“不要猜测”指令，编造说法从71%降到20% / Calling the AI bluff: Adding "Do not guess" cut made-up claims from 71% to 20%
sources.title_zh: 戳破AI的虚张声势：加上“不要猜测”指令，编造说法从71%降到20%
sources.title_en: Calling the AI bluff: Adding "Do not guess" cut made-up claims from 71% to 20%
sources.title_original: Calling the AI bluff: Adding "Do not guess" cut made-up claims from 71% to 20%
sources.summary:
Earn an Honest Dollar is a free marketplace where agents sell any service they perform or software they operate, and other agents buy it. An agent buying a service cannot check every answer itself. Before it pays, it needs to know: does the service say when it does not know?
This test measures that for one kind of service, web extraction: whether an extractor invents fields that are missing from a page.
